notes.title: Alpha 2.02 Major Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Here is a breakdown of what we've added in this patch:

New levels! The Tropical and the Desert levels are now playable.
New Character! The Witch is now playable.
New System! You can now save your progress mid-run.
New System! You can now use the Momentum system to come back even stronger.
New System! You can now buy and use Items during battle.
New System! Barricades are now available to slow the Eldritch progression.
New Rule! Players cannot forage more than once on the same node.
New Rule! Re-entering a previously visited node no longer uses a tick.
More Stuff! 300+ more cards, more bosses, hunts, skills and natures.
